body:
selfhost/emit.prn now supports a function returning a registered struct by value, plus a plain function call as a get-field target -- closing two gaps at once since they're naturally paired. defn-c-return-type recognizes registered struct names the same way Result/Option already were; get-field-shaped?/emit-get-field widened a third time the same day to accept a plain-call target, real terminating mutual recursion with plain-call-shaped?. 7 new tests including a real compile+run+assert check proving a struct genuinely round-trips through a by-value function return and a get-field read. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost domains + bazel build/test clean. PARENA commit 7c93f70.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-hosted compiler: struct-return-type support + non-get-field call as a get-field target
